brief:
Learning objective: students use an interface and inheritance so that a collection can treat
different shapes uniformly.

Target concept: interfaces, subclassing and polymorphic method calls.

Course phase: late.

Scenario: circles, rectangles and squares all report their area and perimeter, and a collection of
shapes adds up the area of everything it contains.

Constraints: a square must be modelled as a special rectangle; include a class diagram; three tasks.

Prerequisites the students already have: classes, constructors, lists, and loops. Not covered yet:
generic types of their own, lambdas, streams.

Expected effort: 30 to 45 minutes.
statement:
# Shape Areas

A drawing app lets users place circles, rectangles and squares on a canvas. To estimate how much paint
a drawing needs, the app adds up the area of every shape on the canvas. Each kind of shape computes
its area and perimeter differently, but the canvas should not have to care which kind of shape it is
looking at.

All shapes implement the interface `Shape`. A `Square` is a special `Rectangle` whose sides are all
equally long, so it extends `Rectangle` and does not compute anything itself.

```plantuml
@startuml
!pragma layout smetana
skinparam ArrowFontSize 16
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam class {
    FontSize 20
    BackgroundColor white
    AttributeFontSize 16
    BorderColor black
    ArrowColor black
}
interface Shape {
  +area(): double
  +perimeter(): double
}
class Circle #lightgrey {
  -radius: double
  +Circle(radius: double)
}
class Rectangle #lightgrey {
  -width: double
  -height: double
  +Rectangle(width: double, height: double)
}
class Square #lightgrey {
  +Square(side: double)
}
class ShapeCollection #lightgrey {
  +add(shape: Shape)
  +totalArea(): double
}
Shape <|.. Circle
Shape <|.. Rectangle
Rectangle <|-- Square
ShapeCollection o-- "*" Shape
@enduml
```

### Tasks

1. [task][Circle]
   Implement `area()` and `perimeter()` in `Circle`. Use `Math.PI`.

2. [task][Rectangle and Square]
   Implement `perimeter()` in `Rectangle`. Complete the constructor of `Square` so that a square with
   side length `s` is a rectangle of width `s` and height `s`.

3. [task][Shape collection]
   Implement `totalArea()` in `ShapeCollection`. It returns the sum of the areas of all shapes in the
   collection, and `0.0` for an empty collection. It must work for every kind of `Shape`, including
   kinds that are added to the app later.
